summary: Onboard new Sr. ML Infra hire: time-limited sudo, laptop + GPU dock provisioning, and policy clarification
description:
Issue summary: Hiring manager requests full onboarding for a new Senior ML Infrastructure Engineer (start date 2026-03-18). The hire needs a company laptop with a GPU docking station, VPN + VPC access, membership in the ml-infra SSO groups, read/write to internal model-artifacts repo, and temporary, auditable sudo on a small set of infra hosts for the first 30 days to perform environment setup.

Impact: Blocking ramp-up for core infra work (expected 2 weeks delay if access or hardware not provided). Security team flagged time-limited sudo as needing policy approval; HR wants confirmation of asset delivery processes.

Background: Candidate cleared by HR and Security for standard access. Team requests a temporary elevated access pattern (time-bounded, recorded) to bootstrap dev environment, install GPU drivers on a test host, and validate training/serving infra.

Request details / ask:
- Provision MacBook Pro 16 (or Linux dev workstation) + external GPU dock (NVIDIA A40 class) and USB-C dock; include spare power adapter.
- Create AD/SSO account, add to groups: ml-infra-developers, model-artifacts-rw, infra-oncall (read).
- VPN and bastion access from day 1, VPC subnet access to dev cluster (us-west-2).
- Grant sudo on labeled bootstrap hosts (infra-bootstrap-1..3) for 30 days; require sudo commands to be forwarded to central audit logging (syslog/splunk).
- Confirm MFA device enrollment and AIDE training completion requirement before granting sudo.
- Clarify policy: can we issue time-limited sudo via temporary role assumption or do we need ephemeral admin tickets each time?

Desired due date: hardware and accounts provisioned by 2026-03-17.
steps_to_grant_access: Create AD user for username: 'e.singh' with standard onboarding template
Add user to SSO groups: ml-infra-developers, model-artifacts-rw
Open ticket with Asset Mgmt to ship laptop + GPU dock to candidate address; mark as high-priority
Request VPN profile creation and bastion account; whitelist source IPs if necessary
Apply sudo role to group 'ml-bootstrapers' scoped to hosts infra-bootstrap-1..3 and set expiry 30 days
Ensure audit forwarding enabled to splunk index: infra-audit and tag entries with 'INT-11856'
investigation_notes: 2026-03-11: HR verified candidate home shipping address and legal paperwork complete (Sana P).
2026-03-12: Security reviewed request - comfortable with time-bounded sudo provided audit logging and MFA enforced (Lina C).
2026-03-13: Asset Mgmt reports limited stock for GPU docks; procurement lead suggests AWS Workstation allocation as fallback.
Checked existing sudo-onboarding runbook (confluence: /confluence/display/INFRA/Sudo+Onboarding) and flagged missing step for expiring roles via IAM path.
Temporary role approach: IAM supports session tags with expiry via STS assume-role; will need small automation to tie to employee ID and ticket key.
comments: Sana Patel (Reporter) - 2026-03-11: Candidate (Esha Singh) confirmed start date 2026-03-18. Please prioritize hardware shipping and SSO groups so she can start onboarding labs on day 1.
Lina Chen (Security) - 2026-03-12: Agree to temporary sudo for bootstrap hosts if we enforce MFA and ship logs to infra-audit. Need confirmation that asset shipping uses company-attested courier.
Diego Morales (Assignee) - 2026-03-12: I'll coordinate with Asset Mgmt and IAM. If docks are short, we can provision an EC2 workstation with GPU and provide SSH access to it as a stopgap.
Asset Mgmt (note) - 2026-03-13: We have 2 docks left in stock. If both allocated, delivery ETA 3 business days. Shipping to Esha's address is allowed under existing relocation policy.

Security Automation - 2026-03-13: Proposed implementation: create transient role 'ml-bootstrap-temporary' with session-duration 86400s x30 and attach policy scoped to hosts. Will need small PR for automation repo.
Diego Morales - 2026-03-14: Raised PR #1247 to infra/automation to create ephemeral-role binding. Tagging INT-11856 in PR description for auditability.
resolution_notes: Pending - asset shipping and final security automation PR required. Once PR merged and asset allocated, will finalize and set expiry on sudo role.
